# AF 第十章 原文（重制基线）

## Chapter 10

[P01] YEARS passed. The seasons came and went, and the short lives of animals flew by. No one remembered the old days before the uprising（起义）, except Clover, Benjamin, Moses the raven, and some pigs; Bluebell, Jessie, and Pincher were dead. Muriel was dead; Bluebell, Jessie, and Pincher were dead. Jones too was dead--he had died in a home for drunk people. Snowball was forgotten. Boxer was forgotten, except by the few who had known him. Clover was an old stout（肥胖的） mare（母马） now, stiff in her joints, and her eyes often ran with water. She was two years past the retiring（退休） age, but no animal had ever really retired（退休的）.

[P02] The idea of keeping a corner of the pasture（牧场） for old animals had long been dropped. Napoleon was now a grown boar（公猪） of twenty-four stone（石头）. Squealer was so fat that he could hardly see. Only old Benjamin was much the same, except a little greyer around the muzzle（口鼻部）, and, after Boxer's death, more sad and silent. There were many more creatures（生物） on the farm now, though the increase was less than expected. Many animals had been born to whom the uprising was only a dim（昏暗的） tradition, passed on by word of mouth, and others had been bought who had never heard of it.

[P03] The farm now had three horses besides Clover. They were fine, strong animals, willing workers and good comrades（同志们）, but very stupid. None of them could learn the alphabet（字母表） past the letter B. They believed everything they were told about the uprising and Animalism（动物主义）, especially from Clover, whom they almost respected like a parent. But it was doubtful（怀疑的） whether they understood much of it. The farm was more prosperous（繁荣的） now and better organised: it had even grown by two fields bought from Mr. Pilkington.
